DesertScourgeDefeated: Use a Desert Medallion in the Desert.
GlowmothDefeated: Use a Suspicious Looking Candle in a glowing mushroom biome.
CrabulonDefeated: Use a Decapodita Sprout in a glowing mushroom biome.
HiveMindDefeated: Break a Hive Tumor in the Corruption; later fights can use a Teratoma.
The first Hive Mind or Perforators kill enchants Aerialite Ore.
PerforatorsDefeated: Break a Perforator Cyst in the Crimson; later fights can use Bloody Worm Food.
The first Hive Mind or Perforators kill enchants Aerialite Ore.
PutridPinkyDefeated: Drops Wormwood, needed for Overloaded Sludge.
PharaohsCurseDefeated: Open the Sarcophagus deep inside the Pyramid.
SlimeGodDefeated: Drops Purified Gel, used in many recipes.
ExcavatorDefeated: Activate the Seismic Station in the Abandoned Village.
AdvisorDefeated: Wake it at the Avaritian Gateway in the Planetarium.
CryogenDefeated: Use a Cryo Key in the Snow biome.
Its first defeat spawns Cryonic Ore, needed for Life Alloy.
AquaticScourgeDefeated: Use Seafood in the Sulphurous Sea.
BrimstoneElementalDefeated: Use a Charred Idol in the Brimstone Crag.
PolarisDefeated: Use a Frosted Key on the Frost Artifact.
Drops Soul of Plight, needed for the Eye of Desolation and Absolute Bars.
CalamitasCloneDefeated: Use an Eye of Desolation at night.
Drops Ashes of Calamity, needed to summon Supreme Calamitas.
LeviathanDefeated: Use a Naiad's Warhorn at the Ocean.
AstrumAureusDefeated: Use an Astral Chunk in the Astral Infection.
Its defeat brings down a new Astral meteor.
PlaguebringerDefeated: Use an Abombination in the Jungle.
Plague enemies only appear after Golem.
LuxDefeated: Destroy a Chaos Construct and its spirit in the Hallow.
AstrumDeusDefeated: Use a Titan Heart (dropped by Atlas) on an Astral Beacon; later fights can use a reusable Starcore.
Its defeat lets you mine Astral Ore.
SubspaceSerpentDefeated: Detonate a Catalyst Bomb in the Underworld Sanctuary.
Unlocks Sanguite Bars, needed for the Profaned Shard.
ProfanedGuardiansDefeated: Use a Profaned Shard in the Hallow or Underworld.
The only source of the Profaned Core, which summons Providence.
DragonfollyDefeated: Use Exotic Pheromones in the Jungle.
Drops Effulgent Feathers for the Yharon Egg. Wild Bumblebirbs also drop them.
ProvidenceDefeated: Use a Profaned Core in the Hallow or Underworld.
CeaselessVoidDefeated: Use a Rune of Kos in the Dungeon.
Drops Dark Plasma for the Cosmic Worm.
StormWeaverDefeated: Use a Rune of Kos in Space.
Drops Armored Shell for the Cosmic Worm.
SignusDefeated: Use a Rune of Kos in the Underworld.
Drops Twisted Netherium for the Cosmic Worm.
PolterghastDefeated: Use a Necroplasmic Beacon in the Dungeon.
Lets the Acid Rain bring the Old Duke.
OldDukeDefeated: Fish in the Sulphurous Sea with a Bloodworm, or wait out a post-Polterghast Acid Rain.
DevourerOfGodsDefeated: Drops Cosmilite, needed for the Cosmic Anvil.
YharonDefeated: Use a Yharon Egg in the Jungle.
Its first defeat spawns Auric Ore.
ExoMechsDefeated: Contact Draedon from a Codebreaker holding an Auric Quantum Cooling Cell.
One of the two final bosses.
SupremeCalamitasDefeated: Offer Ashes of Calamity at the Altar of the Accursed.
One of the two final bosses.
